episodes.title: Wolf Moon
episodes.summary: Everything in Scott McCall's life is starting to fall into place. He gets a spot on the First Line of his Lacrosse team and a date with the woman of his dreams. When he gets bitten by a werewolf, the people around him could be in danger.

episodes.title: Second Chance at First Line
episodes.summary: Scott and Stiles discover that the werewolf curse can also be triggered by anger, besides the full moon. With the lacrosse game coming up, Jackson and his girlfriend, Lydia, hope to humiliate Scott. Will Scott be able to control his rage?

episodes.title: Pack Mentality
episodes.summary: Scott is shaken when his vivid dream of a mauling aboard a school bus turns out to have actually happened. Scott turns to Derek for help, but Derek warns him that his help will not be free. Meanwhile, Scott's long awaited date with Allison turns into a group date. Scott gets bowling help from Allison.

episodes.title: Magic Bullet
episodes.summary: Allison's aunt comes to town and shoots a shadowy werewolf figure with a special bullet that she estimates will kill it within 48 hours. Derek is the one hit and insists that Scott and Stiles help him.

episodes.title: The Tell
episodes.summary: Lydia and Jackson witness a werewolf attack at the video store. Stiles is worried for his father, the sheriff. Allison's aunt gives Allison a family heirloom and encourages her to use it to learn more about the family history. Scott and Allison play hooky on her birthday. Derek confronts Jackson about what he saw the night before. Derek gets a surprise visit. At the parent teacher conference, Scott's mom and Allison's father find out they both skipped school that day. After the parent teacher conference, someone pulls a gun and uses it.

episodes.title: Heart Monitor
episodes.summary: Scott and Stiles are on the outs after Stiles' dad gets hurt, but when Derek insists that Scott avoid Allison, Scott turns to Stiles to help him master his anger with the help of a heart monitor. Meanwhile, Jackson is feeling the effects of having been scratched and approaches Allison claiming to want to get to know her and Scott better.

episodes.title: Night School
episodes.summary: Responding to Scott's howl, the alpha savages Derek and traps Scott and Stiles in their high school. Events escalate even further when Allison, Jackson and Lydia are lured to the school as well with a phony text message.

episodes.title: Lunatic
episodes.summary: As Scott's second full moon approaches, he gives in to his animal urges and hurts Stiles, but Stiles gets a measure of revenge in locking him up. Meanwhile, Jackson continues to try and get closer to Allison. The Argents learn that Scott somehow knew Derek.

episodes.title: Wolf's Bane
episodes.summary: Jackson discovers that he has aconite poisoning and thinks he has figured out what is up with Scott. Meanwhile, Derek hides from the manhunt in Stiles' room while Stiles and Scott try to get Allison's necklace and any clues that may lead to the identity of the alpha. Teammate Danny lends Stiles his internet expertise to help in the search.

episodes.title: Co-Captain
episodes.summary: The Alpha finally reveals himself to Scott and gives him an idea of why he has killed certain people. Argent stages an encounter thinking that Jackson may be a werewolf. Meanwhile, Allison discovers a bit more about her family's secrets and confronts Lydia about her kissing Scott.

episodes.title: Formality
episodes.summary: Kate Argent has Derek chained up in a basement following her attack on his house and shows him off to Allison before torturing him. The coach has banned Scott from the Spring Formal in exchange for not dropping him from the team for academic reasons. Scott intimidates Jackson into escorting Allison to the dance, and she asks Lydia to escort Stiles.

episodes.title: Code Breaker
episodes.summary: Caught in a war between hunters and werewolves, Scott seeks help from friends and enemies.

episodes.title: Omega
episodes.summary: When Lydia goes missing from the hospital, werewolves and hunters alike begin a search to discover not only where she is, but what she's become.

episodes.title: Shape Shifted
episodes.summary: The night before the new full moon, Isaac's father is murdered. When he's taken into custody, Scott, Stiles and Derek resolve to break him out before the Argents get to him first and before the newly bitten teen turns into a werewolf.

episodes.title: Ice Pick
episodes.summary: Scott tries to keep Derek from creating new werewolves; Argent officially begins Allison's training; the new creature in town takes another victim.

episodes.title: Abomination
episodes.summary: The new shape-shifter strikes again, and Scott recruits a reluctant Allison to acquire a rare book in Gerard's collection.

episodes.title: Venomous
episodes.summary: Derek believes that Lydia is the shapeshifter they are after; Scott gathers forces for protection.

episodes.title: Frenemy
episodes.summary: Derek believes that Lydia is the shapeshifter they are after; Scott gathers forces for protection.

episodes.title: Restraint
episodes.summary: As Lydia begins to make connections about the bite from Peter, Jackson causes new problems for Scott and Stiles while Derek has a crisis of faith in his leadership as a new Alpha.

episodes.title: Raving
episodes.summary: Chris, Scott and Stiles struggle with how to stop the Kanima; Scott and Stiles plan to trap the Kanima at a warehouse party, where Erica will also be present, while Allison's mother plans to take Scott down. Chris and his team of hunters face Derek in a confrontation.

episodes.title: Party Guessed
episodes.summary: Even as his relationship with Allison becomes further strained, Scott and Stiles must attend Lydia's birthday party while Derek locks his new wolves up to watch after them on their first full moon together.

episodes.title: Fury
episodes.summary: Allison tracks Derek to the sheriff's station, where Scott, Stiles, Melissa and Sheriff Stilinski are being held hostage.

episodes.title: Battlefield
episodes.summary: Scott plays in the championship lacrosse game and must also figure out a way to stop Gerard. Meanwhile, Allison continues her hunt for Derek and his wolves.

episodes.title: Master Plan
episodes.summary: Scott races to uncover Gerard's master plan following a shocking death on the lacrosse field. Meanwhile, Derek plots to take Gerard down using his own methods.

episodes.title: Tattoo
episodes.summary: Derek and Isaac search for Erica and Boyd, and a new wolf pack arrives in town with its own menacing Alpha.

episodes.title: Chaos Rising
episodes.summary: Allison and Lydia stumble upon a possible clue to finding Boyd and Erica while a childhood friend of Stiles goes missing.

episodes.title: Fireflies
episodes.summary: With Boyd and Cora on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott and Derek must turn to an unlikely ally for help.

episodes.title: Unleashed
episodes.summary: While Scott tries to keep Isaac from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles attempts to prove his theory that the killings have nothing to do with werewolves.

episodes.title: Frayed
episodes.summary: During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

episodes.title: Motel California
episodes.summary: Stranded at a motel for the night because of the postponed cross country meet, Scott and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer's newest targets.

episodes.title: Currents
episodes.summary: As the danger begins to reach closer to Scott, threatening his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton, Kali and the Twins go after Derek.

episodes.title: Visionary
episodes.summary: Seeking answers, Scott, Allison and Stiles hear stories told by two unlikely narrators and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
episodes.summary: As Allison begins to suspect someone dangerously close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott and Stiles conclude that Lydia's rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

episodes.title: The Overlooked
episodes.summary: Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital by a powerful storm, Scott and Derek must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora's life.

episodes.title: Alpha Pact
episodes.summary: With the threat growing far more personal and time running out on innocent lives, Scott is forced to make a difficult choice in order to save both friends and family. Derek and Peter try to figure out how to save Cora's life.

episodes.title: Lunar Ellipse
episodes.summary: Under Deaton's advice, Scott and his friends use an ancient but extremely dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion from achieving his sinister goal.

episodes.title: Anchors
episodes.summary: Three weeks after saving the lives of their parents, Scott, Stiles and Allison begin to suffer strange side effects from their ritual sacrifice. At the same time, the newly enlightened Sheriff Stilinski scours through old cases.

episodes.title: More Bad Than Good
episodes.summary: Scott and his friends race to figure out how to catch the Werecoyote before it's hunted down while Derek and Peter are broken out of captivity by an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Galvanize
episodes.summary: On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

episodes.title: Illuminated
episodes.summary: With Beacon Hills under curfew due to the power outage, the teens decide to throw a black light Halloween party while Scott tries to get Kira to trust him in the midst of an attack by a strange new threat.

episodes.title: Silverfinger
episodes.summary: Scott's friends pledge to protect him against him against an increasingly hostile enemy while Argent, Isaac and Allison search for answers through an old adversary from the Japanese Yakuza.

episodes.title: Riddled
episodes.summary: When Stiles goes missing in the middle of the night, Scott and the others embark on a desperate search while Lydia tries to master her new abilities.

episodes.title: Letharia Vulpina
episodes.summary: Signs of sabotage appearing all around them, Scott and his allies desperately try to figure out how to prevent disaster as Lydia and Allison seek an unlikely teacher to focus her power.

episodes.title: Echo House
episodes.summary: Scott and his friends seek an important Japanese artifact while a mental health institution called Eichen House offers both answers and a difficult choice for Stiles.

episodes.title: The Fox and the Wolf
episodes.summary: An important clue to defeating their enemy is revealed through the story of a World War II Japanese-American Internment camp while Kira's role becomes ever more crucial as she begins to realize her own unusual abilities.

episodes.title: De-Void
episodes.summary: With Deaton and Peter's help, Scott and Lydia combine their abilities in a desperate attempt to gain the upper hand. At the same time, Stilinski faces a review board that may decide his future.

episodes.title: Insatiable
episodes.summary: Kira finds herself facing an unexpected antagonist while Scott and his friends try to survive against an enemy growing ever stronger.

episodes.title: The Divine Move
episodes.summary: Struck by disaster and nearly defeated, Scott and Derek call on their friends and allies to make one last stand.

episodes.title: The Dark Moon
episodes.summary: Scott searches for a missing friend in Mexico in the Season 4 premiere.
Scott turns to an unlikely ally in order to stop Kate.

episodes.title: Muted
episodes.summary: Scott's position on the lacrosse team is threatened. Meanwhile, Stilinski investigates a murder.

episodes.title: The Benefactor
episodes.summary: Uninvited guests arrive at Lydia's lake house. Meanwhile, Derek tracks down a killer.

episodes.title: I.E.D.
episodes.summary: Lydia seeks help with her powers; Scott, Stiles and Kira play in their first lacrosse game.

episodes.title: Orphaned
episodes.summary: Scott is forced to help a dangerous enemy. Meanwhile, Derek and Malia track down an old ally.

episodes.title: Weaponized
episodes.summary: A mysterious outbreak hits the high school.

episodes.title: Time of Death
episodes.summary: Scott carries out a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, Malia confronts her past.

episodes.title: Perishable
episodes.summary: An assassin targets Scott and Liam at the lacrosse team's annual bonfire. Later, Lydia uncovers a family secret.

episodes.title: Monstrous
episodes.summary: Scott and Kira protect Satomi's pack from assassins. Meanhwile, Stiles and Malia discover the origins of the Dead Pool.

episodes.title: A Promise to the Dead
episodes.summary: Scott battles an old enemy.

episodes.title: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: Scott and Stiles save the pack from Kate in the Season 4 finale.

episodes.title: Creatures of the Night
episodes.summary: On the eve of the start of senior year, Scott and his pack are challenged by the arrival of a new enemy.

episodes.title: Parasomnia
episodes.summary: Stiles tries to prove his suspicions about a new classmate; Lydia helps a student who suffers from night terrors.

episodes.title: Dreamcatchers
episodes.summary: Scott tracks a dangerous shapeshifter that has been threatening Stilinski; Malia receives information about her mother.

episodes.title: Condition Terminal
episodes.summary: Stiles works on tracking down a fugitive; Liam attempts to be wingman for Mason while at a nightclub.

episodes.title: A Novel Approach
episodes.summary: The pack enters Eichen House in order to learn more about the Dread Doctors.

episodes.title: Required Reading
episodes.summary: Scott and his friends follow Dr. Valack's advice; and experience strange effects as a result.

episodes.title: Strange Frequencies
episodes.summary: Scott's plans to protect the newest victim are derailed when The Dread Doctors attack.

episodes.title: Ouroboros
episodes.summary: Scott and Malia try to rescue captured friends; Deaton discovers something horrific about The Dread Doctors.

episodes.title: Lies of Omission
episodes.summary: Scott turns to an unlikely ally for help; and Stiles and Lydia seek the truth about Parrish.

episodes.title: Status Asthmaticus
episodes.summary: Scott and the pack face what may be their biggest threat yet.

episodes.title: The Last Chimera
episodes.summary: Scott and Stiles try to learn what is behind the mysterious infection that is killing the town sheriff in spite of their deep rift.

episodes.title: Damnatio Memoriae
episodes.summary: Even without the support of his pack, Scott considers what the Dread Doctors' success means for Beacon Hills.

episodes.title: Codominance
episodes.summary: Kira and her mother make a journey to help Kira deal with her dark side; Lydia is surprised at Eichen House.

episodes.title: The Sword and the Spirit
episodes.summary: Scott tries to put his pack back together; and Malia and a new ally set out to rescue Deaton from the Desert Wolf.

episodes.title: Amplification
episodes.summary: Stiles learns that Lydia is in imminent danger and develops a plan to break her out of Eichen House. Theo, however, has his own plans for her.

episodes.title: Lie Ability
episodes.summary: Scott hopes to rescue Lydia, who's trapped in Eichen House with Theo and his Chimera Pack.

episodes.title: A Credible Threat
episodes.summary: Scott and the pack try to use a charity lacrosse game to figure out the identity of the Beast.

episodes.title: The Maid of Gévaudan
episodes.summary: The Argents share an important clue about the mystery of the Beast of Gevaudan; and Scott tries to take on the Beast by himself.

episodes.title: The Beast of Beacon Hills
episodes.summary: With the identity of the Beast finally revealed, Scott and his friends are in a race against time to stop the Dread Doctors from implementing their final plan.

episodes.title: Apotheosis
episodes.summary: Scott and his friends try to stop the Beast before Beacon Hills is razed to the ground.

episodes.title: Memory Lost
episodes.summary: With graduation approaching, a supernatural force rides into Beacon Hills and crosses paths with Scott and his friends, while Liam discovers evidence of a new enemy in the high school.

episodes.title: Superposition
episodes.summary: While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for lost memories of a missing friend, Corey discovers a connection between his abilities and the Wild Hunt.

episodes.title: Sundowning
episodes.summary: Scott, Lydia and Malia search for Stiles; Liam and the others throw a party in order to keep a friend safe from the Ghost Riders.

episodes.title: Relics
episodes.summary: Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.

episodes.title: Radio Silence
episodes.summary: Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles's Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.

episodes.title: Ghosted
episodes.summary: Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Cannan while Liam and and Hayden take drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.summary: Scott and Liam make an attempt to capture a Ghost Rider; Malia and Peter try to find a way into the Wild Hunt.

episodes.title: Blitzkrieg
episodes.summary: Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in an attempt to get Stiles back; and Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.

episodes.title: Memory Found
episodes.summary: Liam and Theo act as decoys while Scott, Lydia and Malia try to remember Stiles.

episodes.title: Riders on the Storm
episodes.summary: With the fate of Beacon Hills hanging in the balance, Scott and his pack face off against Douglas in a final showdown.

episodes.title: Said the Spider to the Fly
episodes.summary: As Scott prepares Beacon Hills for his imminent departure, a mysterious presence breaks out of Eichen House.

episodes.title: Raw Talent
episodes.summary: Scott and Malia search for the owner of a unique bullet, fearing that a new breed of werewolf hunter has come to Beacon Hills. At the same time, Lydia must face her own fears of Eichen House.

episodes.title: After Images
episodes.summary: While Scott and the others desperately pursue a missing werewolf, Melissa McCall and Chris Argent investigate the nature of a strange body.

episodes.title: Face-to-Faceless
episodes.summary: Scott, Lydia and Malia have to take drastic measures to quell the growing violence in Beacon Hills, while Liam endures his own gauntlet at the high school.

episodes.title: Pressure Test
episodes.summary: When Scott and the others try to protect two new werewolves, an unlikely ally joins the fight.

episodes.title: Triggers
episodes.summary: Liam and Theo attempt to draw the Hunters away from Beacon Hills.

episodes.title: Werewolves of London
episodes.summary: After a shocking attack leaves the pack reeling, Scott sets out to recruit reinforcements.

episodes.title: Genotype
episodes.summary: Scott and the others must make a discovery before it's too late.

episodes.title: Broken Glass
episodes.summary: Scott and Malia prepare for battle while Argent searches for an old ally.

episodes.title: The Wolves of War
episodes.summary: Gerard initiates his final attack on the Supernaturals of Beacon Hills.
